svg.title: BrewLite A2 - Ingredient checkout: reserve, pay, cancel

g.text: BrewLite A2 - Ingredient checkout: reserve, pay, cancel
Check selected sizes/toppings and aggregate cart availability
Validate card; disable confirm; create payment key
POST /orders with JWT and cart; no client prices
Keep cart; show shortage; link to edit cart
Keep orderId / owner / same payment key
Re-login same Customer; GET order and check owner/status;
resume existing order/key, never POST another order
201 SUCCESS; receipt and tracking; clear cart
Keep cart/order; offer retry same order or cancel
Retry same order/key; no new reservation;
leaving retains reservation, no automatic expiry
BEGIN; lock recipes in ID order;
read base and topping recipes; aggregate ALL cart lines;
lock ingredients in ID order; check onHand - reserved
Increase reserved; create Order PENDING marker true;
create OrderItems and immutable OrderIngredient snapshot; COMMIT
If retry, transition PAYMENT_FAILED to PENDING;
Never use edited recipes to consume old snapshots.
Failure before commit rolls back; simulator has no real money.
Legacy marker false uses original Product.stock lifecycle.
decrease onHand AND reserved by snapshot;
save one Payment SUCCESS + Order PAID; COMMIT
Save Payment FAILED + Order PAYMENT_FAILED; COMMIT;
Repeated cancel returns 409; no second release.
Legacy false marker restores Product.stock instead.
Same cancellation applies directly to PENDING orders.
BEGIN; lock Order; validate owner and unpaid state;
lock ingredients by ID; decrease reserved by snapshot;
